title: unified rollouts: canary, A/B, shadow traffic and automated rollback workflows
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: Provide a single, consistent rollout and model lifecycle API and controller that supports canary rollouts, A/B experiments, shadow traffic, and automated rollback based on application and quality metrics. This PR adds the rollout controller (CRD + controller), API endpoints, console UX for guided rollouts, server-side traffic-splitting logic, shadowing support, and an automated rollback engine that evaluates latency/error-rate/quality signals and triggers safe rollbacks.

What changed (high level):
- New Rollout CRD and controller: declarative rollout spec that supports canary steps, percent-based traffic splits, A/B experiments, and shadow targets. The controller manages step progression, metrics aggregation, and rollback triggers.
- API: POST/GET endpoints to create/manage rollouts, start/stop experiments, and query rollout status. Integrates with Smart Routing to apply traffic rules.
- Console: Rollout wizard and rollout history view with step-by-step UI for canary and A/B tests, plus visualized metrics and a manual override.
- Automated rollback: policy engine that evaluates configured SLOs (latency, error rate) and evaluation-based quality checks (integration with evals harness) and initiates safe rollback or pause.
- Shadow traffic: option to mirror a percentage of production traffic to a candidate model for offline quality evaluation without impacting users.
- Observability: rollout-level metrics, traces, and audit logs; new dashboards and alert targets.
- Tests: unit and integration tests for the controller, routing logic, and rollback engine; e2e smoke tests for basic canary flows.

Checklist:
- [x] Rollout CRD + controller implemented
- [x] API endpoints and permission checks
- [x] Console UX for guided rollouts
- [x] Automated rollback policy engine + test coverage
- [x] Shadow traffic plumbing + docs and examples
- [x] Integration tests (CI) and e2e smoke test
- [x] Release notes and migration guide

Compatibility notes: Backwards-compatible for existing model serving APIs. New rollout features are opt-in; existing deployments continue to use simple pinning/route configs. Migration guide added to docs/rollouts.md.

Risk and mitigations: Controller operates via CRD and leader election to avoid dual-writes. Traffic routing changes are guarded behind a canary flag in the Smart Routing table and require the rollout controller to apply rules. Automated rollback uses conservative defaults (multiple signal confirmations and cooldown windows) to avoid flip-flopping.

Related: ENG-4123 (rollouts design), PM-220 (roadmap), RFC for rollout CRD linked in description.
